limitations: The review uses the original owner submissions and earlier full-document review. No fresh owner decision, new activation, trial, or changed historical acceptance is inferred.
review: Preserved W1 owner submission approves internal phases, Auto default, bounded separate resolution/criticism/arbitration and explicit Manual. Standalone plan/report, release/deployment and retrospective operations remain outside the initial approved set.

The associated design proposal and full-document review record retain alternatives, costs, scope exclusions and resolved review findings.

Preserved W3 actual owner direction supersedes default plugin bundles and fixed placement exclusions while retaining explicit consent, open source/parameter selection, exact-ID removal and parked-run guards. The ordered occurrence amendment records a separate confirmed A–B–A direction.

Current pilot plans identify their approved decision inputs, and comparable execution was authorized separately. The approval records themselves supply no execution, acquisition, publication, recommendation, or additional workflow-stage authority.
